body:
You can use these short sermons in your personal reflection,

 Your congregation can use one or all of them over the next 3 weeks (permission granted), and

 You can share them with your friends to invite them into a conversation …

 https://www.votecommongood.com/resources-for-pastors/

 I hope they will be of help:

 A Theology of Voting,

 A Theology of Politics, and

 A Theology of Democracy.

Obviously, a single short sermon can’t say everything that needs to be said on any subject. But I trust these can inspire you to think more deeply on these important topics at this critical moment!

 https://www.votecommongood.com/resources-for-pastors/
